integrity: Proof is analytic and self-contained; the supplied finite checks are corroborative, not substitutes for infinite or continuous arguments. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
limitations: The formula is sharp only within the permutation-equivariant two-dimensional matrix subspace; the full real 3-column Plücker constant is bounded below but not determined. Unindexed prior equivalent results remain possible.
title: Golden-ratio Plücker witness and the sharp permutation-equivariant determinant profile
